---
# pagetitle sets only the browser tab; the visible title is the H1 below, which
# also renders in the knit_child pkgdown embed.
pagetitle: "Ineligible Participant Overview"
output:
  html_document:
    mathjax: null
    md_extensions: "-tex_math_dollars"
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
      smooth_scroll: true
    css: styles.css
params:
  dfResults: NA
  dfMetrics: NA
  dfGroups: NA
  lListings: NA
  strMode: basic
  dfStatusHistory: NA
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Data contract (see ?Report_Eligibility): lListings$IE_denom is
# Mapped_EXCLUSION; params$strMode picks basic or pilot mode,
# optional lListings$IE_records (level 2) fills the listing's records, and the optional
# params$dfStatusHistory (level 3) adds Status over Time. R derives every status and
# count; eligFilters.js only filters.
library(gsm.kri)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

dfResults <- params$dfResults
dfMetrics <- params$dfMetrics
dfGroups <- params$dfGroups
lListings <- params$lListings
dfExclusion <- if (!is.null(lListings$IE_denom)) lListings$IE_denom else lListings$IE_num
dfRecords <- lListings$IE_records

strMode <- elig_Mode(dfExclusion, params$strMode)
bPilot <- strMode == "pilot"
dfElig <- elig_ClassifyParticipants(dfExclusion, dfGroups, strMode)
vSources <- elig_Sources(dfElig)
bHasEdcQuery <- elig_HasSource(dfElig, "flag_edc_query")
bHasEdcPd <- elig_HasSource(dfElig, "flag_edc_pd")
vNotDelivered <- if (bPilot) c("EDC Query", "EDC PD")[!c(bHasEdcQuery, bHasEdcPd)] else character()
bRecords <- bPilot && is.data.frame(dfRecords) && nrow(dfRecords) > 0

strRateID <- elig_RateMetricID(dfResults)
dfRate <- dfResults[dfResults$MetricID == strRateID, ]
dfRateMetric <- dfMetrics[dfMetrics$MetricID == strRateID, ]
dfTrend <- elig_TrendRows(params$dfStatusHistory)
latest_snapshot <- max(as.Date(dfResults$SnapshotDate))
strStudyID <- paste(unique(stats::na.omit(dfElig$studyid)), collapse = ", ")

status_rows <- lapply(
  c(study = "study", country = "country", site = "site"),
  function(level) elig_StatusRows(dfElig, level)
)
source_data <- elig_SourceRows(dfElig)
criteria_data <- elig_CriteriaRows(dfElig)
vStatusColors <- elig_StatusColors(bPilot)
vSourceColors <- vStatusColors[setdiff(names(vStatusColors), "No Eligibility Risk")]
vCriterionColors <- c(Inclusion = "#3C587F", Exclusion = "#8FB3DE", Other = "#B8C4D6")[unique(criteria_data$study$Status)]
has_criteria <- length(criteria_data$order) > 0

dfListing <- elig_ListingData(dfElig)
dfPartRecords <- elig_ParticipantRecords(dfElig, if (bRecords) dfRecords)
dfExport <- elig_ExportData(dfListing, dfPartRecords, bRecords)

vDelivered <- unname(c(
  "EDC eCRF",
  if (any(names(vSources) %in% c("flag_pd", "flag_pd_important"))) "Protocol Deviation",
  if (bHasEdcQuery) "EDC Query",
  if (bHasEdcPd) "EDC PD"
))

status_note <- function(level) {
  cat(
    "\n> One bar per ", level,
    if (level == "study") ", as % of its enrolled participants. Use the chart's position control for counts." else ", by count of its enrolled participants. Use the chart's position control for the 100% view.",
    if (level != "study") paste0(
      " Click a ", level, " bar to filter the ",
      if (level == "country") "site charts, flag sources, criteria and listings" else "flag sources, criteria and listings",
      ". Use the Show buttons to keep only the ", if (level == "country") "countries" else "sites",
      " with flagged participants; their bars keep every status."
    ),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
sources_note <- paste0(
  "\n> Participants in scope flagged by each source, by their overall status",
  if (bPilot) " (Ineligible wins over Potentially Ineligible)" else "",
  ". A participant can count under several sources. Hover for % of enrolled.",
  paste(sprintf(" %s is not delivered for this study.", vNotDelivered), collapse = ""),
  "\n"
)
criteria_note <- "\n> EDC I/E eCRF criteria only. Participants flagged only by a PD, a query or an EDC PD have no criterion codes and do not appear here.\n"
```

```{r page-css, results='asis'}
# Inline and literal hex: the pkgdown embed loads neither styles.css nor its
# var(--...) tokens.
cat('
<style>
#TOC #tocify-header0 { display: block; }
/* Full window width: the listings have one wide column per source. div.* outranks the 1200px cap
   that toc_float sets on div.main-container; the pkgdown embed has no main-container. */
div.main-container { max-width: none; padding-left: 24px; padding-right: 24px; }
@media (min-width: 992px) {
  .main-container > .row > .col-md-3 { width: 290px; }
  .main-container > .row > .toc-content.col-md-9 { width: calc(100% - 290px); }
}
#toc-toggle { z-index: 1030 !important; }
.elig-filter-strip { position: sticky; top: 48px; z-index: 1029; display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; background-color: #f1f7fe; border-bottom: 1px solid #cfe3fb; padding: 8px 14px; margin: 0 0 16px; }
.elig-filter-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5b7193; }
.elig-filter-hint { font-size: 13px; color: #5b7193; }
.elig-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #3C587F; border-radius: 16px; padding: 3px 6px 3px 12px; font-size: 13px; color: #3C587F; }
.elig-chip-value { font-weight: 600; }
.elig-chip button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 18px; height: 18px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 50%; background-color: transparent; color: #3C587F; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; }
.elig-chip button:hover { background-color: #3C587F; color: #ffffff; }
.elig-chip button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3C587F; outline-offset: 2px; }
.elig-cards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(190px, 1fr)); gap: 12px; margin: 8px 0 18px; }
.elig-card { background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e3e8ef; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 14px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04); }
.elig-card-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #5b7193; }
.elig-card-value { font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: #1f2d3d; line-height: 1.2; }
.elig-card-sub { font-size: 12px; color: #6b7a90; }
.elig-badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 10px; padding: 1px 9px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }
.elig-kri-badge { background-color: #3C587F; color: #ffffff; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 0 7px; margin-left: 6px; vertical-align: 1px; cursor: help; }
.elig-note { color: #5b7193; font-size: 13px; }
.elig-status-filter { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin: 6px 0 8px; font-size: 13px; color: #3C587F; }
.elig-status-filter-label { font-weight: 600; }
.elig-status-filter-options { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid #3C587F; border-radius: 16px; overflow: hidden; }
.elig-status-filter-options button { border: none; background-color: #ffffff; color: #3C587F; padding: 3px 12px; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; }
.elig-status-filter-options button + button { border-left: 1px solid #3C587F; }
.elig-status-filter-options button.active { background-color: #3C587F; color: #ffffff; }
.elig-status-filter-options button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3C587F; outline-offset: -3px; }
.elig-status-count { color: #5b7193; }
.elig-status-filter-active .elig-status-count { color: #3C587F; font-weight: 600; }
.elig-status-empty { flex-basis: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; background-color: #f6f8fb; border: 1px dashed #b8c4d6; color: #5b7193; }
.elig-empty { color: #5b7193; font-style: italic; }
.elig-map { border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13px; margin: 6px 0 10px; }
.elig-map th, .elig-map td { border: 1px solid #e3e8ef; padding: 4px 8px; text-align: center; }
.elig-map tbody th { text-align: left; }
.elig-map-total { font-weight: 600; background-color: #f6f8fb; }
.elig-truncate { white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; max-width: 260px; cursor: help; }
.elig-detail { padding: 8px 16px; background-color: #f8fafc; }
#map-wrap-country, #map-wrap-site { overflow-x: auto; }
/* Clears the navbar and the sticky strip when a contents link jumps to a section. */
.section.level2, .section.level3 { scroll-margin-top: 100px; }
</style>
')
```

# Ineligible Participant Overview

```{r header, results='asis'}
cat(sprintf(
  "**Study:** %s  \n*Snapshot date: %s* &nbsp;|&nbsp; *Sources: %s*\n\n",
  strStudyID, format(latest_snapshot), paste(vDelivered, collapse = ", ")
))
```

```{r filter-strip}
# htmltools, not raw HTML, so pandoc does not wrap the controls in a <p>.
chip <- function(key, label) {
  htmltools::tags$span(
    id = paste0("elig-chip-", key), class = "elig-chip", style = "display:none;",
    htmltools::tags$span(label, ": ", htmltools::tags$span(class = "elig-chip-value")),
    htmltools::tags$button(
      type = "button", `data-elig-clear` = key,
      `aria-label` = paste("Clear", tolower(label), "filter"), htmltools::HTML("&times;")
    )
  )
}
htmltools::tags$div(
  id = "elig-filter-strip", class = "elig-filter-strip",
  htmltools::tags$span(class = "elig-filter-eyebrow", "Filters"),
  htmltools::tags$span(
    id = "elig-filter-hint", class = "elig-filter-hint",
    "None. Click a country or site bar to filter."
  ),
  chip("country", "Country"),
  chip("site", "Site")
)
```

## Study Overview

```{r overview}
elig_OverviewCards(dfElig, bPilot)
```

## Time Series {.tabset .tabset-pills}

### Ineligibility Rate

```{r ts}
gsm.kri::Widget_TimeSeries(
  dfResults = dplyr::mutate(dfRate, Flag = NA),
  lMetric = as.list(dfRateMetric),
  dfGroups = dfGroups,
  strOutcome = "Metric",
  bAddGroupSelect = FALSE,
  selectedGroupIDs = unique(dfRate$GroupID)
)
```

```{r ts-status-tab, results='asis', eval=bPilot && nrow(dfTrend) > 0}
cat("\n### Status over Time\n\n")
```

```{r ts-status, eval=bPilot && nrow(dfTrend) > 0}
gsm.vizr::bars(
  data = dfTrend,
  spec = elig_TrendBarSpec(),
  metadata = list(chartId = "elig-trend-status")
)
```

```{r ts-status-note, results='asis', eval=bPilot && nrow(dfTrend) > 0}
cat(sprintf(
  '<p class="elig-note">Enrolled participants by eligibility status at each snapshot, from %s. History starts at the study\'s go-live and is never back-filled. The Ineligibility Rate can step up at go-live because the eligibility PD categories widened.</p>',
  min(dfTrend$GroupID)
))
```

## Study {.tabset .tabset-pills}

### Status

```{r study-status}
gsm.vizr::bars(
  data = status_rows$study,
  spec = elig_StatusBarSpec("study", status_rows$study$GroupID, bPilot),
  metadata = list(chartId = "elig-study-status", level = "study"),
  height = 230,
  minHeight = 230
)
```

```{r study-status-note, results='asis'}

```

### Flag Sources

```{r study-sources}

)
```
